## Overview（原文）

The SmartByte LT-IS3005G-5GT-M-AD is the compact size unmanaged industrial grade Ethernet switch with 5-port 10/100/1000Base-T RJ45. It is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, such as wide range power DC/AC input, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation temperature from
-40 ℃ ~+75℃
as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability and so on. It is the best choice for heavy
industrial field where installation space is limited and restricted

## Features（原文）

- 5*10/100/1000Base-TX RJ45 ports
- DC9-58V, AC 15~40V input, redundant power supply with polarity reverse protection
- Support 2Kbytes Jumbo frame
- Support 4KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
- IP40 fan-less and Din-rail hardware design
- Operation temperature: -40 ℃ ~+75℃
